## OWNER DELTA — accepted main advanced via docs-only PR #52 (2026-11-12)

**Important coordination only — your existing Phase C instructions remain in force; this is not a new QA oracle revision.**

Owner separately source/visual/CI-reviewed and exact-SHA merged [PR #52](https://github.com/gloweaseco-leo/VRAE/pull/52) (RA3D Phase0.5 synthetic offline UI only, all 182 changes under its own docs folder; no VRAE production/QA tests/CI changes). GitHub `main` was re-read and is now exactly **`696d4ae695041f0eeefa56d22039682a989380b2`**; previous accepted main was `61b88eb31d1dec668e7e05495b88fe2d8a5b25fe`.

Your current PR #48 at read-time `b74318110ba14a23e6db6af393d4f8226ed33443` has a GitHub workflow run [43186042273](https://github.com/gloweaseco-leo/VRAE/actions/runs/43186042273) associated with the **previous main**, and at this checkpoint that run was in progress. Preserve its actual results (success or failure); **do not pretend it tested the new main**. When preparing the **final** Phase C exact SHA, normally `fetch origin && merge --no-edit origin/main` in your own QA worktree (no rebase/force), verify 100% accepted main blobs/modes preserved, and run the already required **four new hosted CI jobs on updated main + final QA HEAD**, with original checkout parents verified.

Do not alter frozen V1/V2 business assertions, source facts or rejection behavior for the sake of a green job. Exact V1 historical RED still must be independently runnable and transparently disclosed; frozen V2 118 must be genuinely collected in default CI. Keep PR #48 Draft for separate Owner FINAL PASS. **No need to restart a job midflight or resend previous work; just reanchor final testing to the new main.**

Codex-2 owns PR #52 and future separate offline prototyping. RA3D production still NO-GO, Human Gold 0/26, customer sharing NO-GO.
